name: nginx-multisite
description: Nginx web server with multi-site virtual host support, SSL termination, HTTP→HTTPS redirection, and security hardening. Also configures fail2ban, UFW firewall rules, SSH hardening, and kernel-level sysctl security parameters.

name: cache
description: Caching layer that installs and configures both Memcached and Redis on the same host, with Redis password authentication. Includes a post-install config-file patching workaround to strip deprecated directives written by the redisio cookbook.

name: fastapi-tutorial
description: Deploys a FastAPI Python application from GitHub into /opt/fastapi-tutorial, sets up a Python virtual environment, provisions a PostgreSQL database and user, and registers a systemd service running uvicorn on port 8000.
